$note: Which files each building on the architecture map is made of. Every file matched by `sources` in architecture.config.json must be claimed exactly once; anything nobody claims shows up as UNCLAIMED in the generated file and as a drift count on the page. Keys beginning with $ are notes, not modules.
$folding: Seventeen of the twenty-nine modules stand on their own. The remaining twelve are folded into four buildings -- `goldenset`, `probes`, `trace` and `evaluate` -- because they are genuinely one job each (constructing the labelled set; investigating a measured failure; recording a run and proving the recording still matches the pipeline; scoring the golden set in aggregate and case by case) and twenty-nine separate buildings stops being readable. The partition is still total: every module is claimed.
